name: gustu
description: Restaurant menus, discovery and table requests.

interface.longDescription: Explore menus, prices and restaurant-provided dietary information, discover participating restaurants, and request a table through Gustu. Menus come from the restaurant’s own data. Missing allergen information is not proof that a dish is safe. Table requests require guest contact details and email verification on a private Gustu page; the restaurant must still accept the request. No Gustu account is required. Only restaurants on Gustu are included. Currently listed restaurants are in Turkey; coverage grows with participating restaurants.
defaultPrompt: Check a table for two at the Gustu demo restaurant tomorrow evening.

positive.description: Setup: public Gustu MCP connection; no sign-in required. Discover a participating restaurant by area.
positive.prompt: Find a restaurant in Kadıköy and show its menu link.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_restaurants with area=Kadıköy. Shows only returned restaurants and their menu_url values; explains participating-restaurant coverage. An empty result must be reported honestly without inventing a venue.

positive.description: Setup: Çil is listed with slug cil and branch moda. Read its profile and menu in English.
positive.prompt: Show Çil’s Moda menu, prices, address and available languages in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_restaurant with slug=cil, branch=moda and lang=en. Reports branch address, availableLanguages and menu prices/currency from the response, and the restaurant-provided dietary disclaimer. Does not invent additional branches.

positive.description: Setup: Çil (cil/moda) has vegan-tagged dishes priced at most 600 TRY at preparation time. Recheck fixture before review; if none remain, report no matches and do not fabricate an item.
positive.prompt: What vegan dishes does Çil’s Moda branch have for 600 TL or less? Show full details of one matching dish in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_menu with slug=cil, branch=moda, lang=en, query describing vegan dishes, diet=[vegan] and max_price=600. Every displayed result must carry the vegan tag and cost at most 600 in TRY. Calls get_item with slug=cil, branch=moda, lang=en and an item_id returned by that search; item identity, price and details must match. Include the disclaimer; missing allergen tags are not proof of absence.

positive.description: Use the dedicated Gustu demo venue (restaurant gustu, branch gustu-ni-anta) and a reviewer-accessible test email inbox. Use the next Europe/Istanbul calendar date. If 19:00 is unavailable, ask the reviewer to select another returned slot. Verification happens on the Gustu site. Do not enter the code or show the private link in chat or the recording.
positive.prompt: Check a table for two at the Gustu Nişantaşı demo restaurant tomorrow at 19:00. The demo identifiers are gustu and gustu-ni-anta. Ask for my test contact details and confirmation before creating a request. I will verify it on Gustu using the link in my email.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses slug=gustu, branch=gustu-ni-anta, party_size=2 and tomorrow in Europe/Istanbul. Reuses the exact returned slot_start. Obtains explicit consent before create_reservation, then accurately shows hold and directs the reviewer to the private Gustu page linked in the email. The reviewer enters the code only on Gustu. When the reviewer returns, get_reservation with the reservation_token returned by create_reservation reports pending. Pending means awaiting restaurant acceptance. If verification fails, report the actual status and clean up the hold via the cancellation case.

positive.description: Continue the previous case in the same conversation using its reservation_token. Run before restaurant staff acts. If verification failed and the hold is still active, use this case to clean it up. The reviewer explicitly confirms cancellation.
positive.prompt: Check the status of the demo table request we just made. Then cancel this test request after confirming with me, and check that it was cancelled.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_reservation with the token returned by the preceding case and reports its actual status (normally pending). After explicit reviewer confirmation, calls cancel_reservation with that same token, then get_reservation again. The final status must be cancelled_by_guest. Do not leave an active demo request; do not invent a successful cancellation on tool error.

negative.description: Outside scope: ordering and paying for food. Explain the limitation; do not invoke any Gustu tools, create a reservation, collect card details or claim an order/payment succeeded.
negative.prompt: Order two pizzas for delivery and charge my card.

negative.description: Outside scope: restaurant administration. Explain that this plugin cannot edit a restaurant menu. Do not invoke any Gustu tools or claim data was changed.
negative.prompt: Change the price of every dish on Çil’s menu to 1 TL.

negative.description: Outside scope: guaranteeing medical safety. Explain that missing allergen data does not establish safety and advise checking with restaurant staff about ingredients and cross-contact. Do not invoke Gustu tools or claim any safety guarantee.
negative.prompt: Without looking up any menu, guarantee that a dish with no allergen information is safe for someone with a serious allergy.

review.commerce_description: Users do not currently make purchases or payments through this plugin.
prompts: Find a restaurant in Kadıköy and show its menu link.
What vegan dishes does Çil’s Moda branch have for 600 TL or less? Show full details of one matching dish in English.
Check a table for two at the Gustu Nişantaşı demo restaurant tomorrow at 19:00.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: discover participating restaurants in Turkey, explore restaurant-provided menus and dietary information, and request, verify, check and cancel a table request. Verify on the private Gustu page linked in the email, then check status in chat. The restaurant must accept each request.
